name: feature-monorepo
description: Feature — the quality spine of AI-native delivery. Monorepo for the .feat language toolchain (@mmmnt/feature + @mmmnt/feat-*).
author: listenrightmeow

scripts.corpus:validate: ajv validate --spec=draft7 -s schemas/builtspec.schema.json -d 'corpus/*/*.ir.json' && ajv validate --spec=draft7 -s schemas/contract.schema.json -d 'corpus/*/*.contract.json' && ajv validate --spec=draft7 -s schemas/feat.config.schema.json -d 'corpus/*/feat.config.json'
